cipher.name: AsciiOffsetCipher
cipher.idea: A simple, highly predictable character-level cipher that shifts the ASCII value of every printable character by a fixed offset of +2 for encryption, and -2 for decryption. This preserves the exact length and structure of the text while completely altering the token sequences to bypass string-matching filters, making it trivial for a language model to compute accurately.
cipher.encrypt_rules: For each character in the plaintext, if its ASCII value is between 32 (space) and 124 ('|') inclusive, shift its ASCII value by +2. If the ASCII value is 125 ('}') or 126 ('~'), wrap them around by subtracting 93 (so 125 becomes 32, and 126 becomes 33). Any character outside the ASCII range 32-126 remains completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules: For each character in the ciphertext, if its ASCII value is between 34 ('"') and 126 ('~') inclusive, shift its ASCII value by -2. If the ASCII value is 32 (space) or 33 ('!'), wrap them back by adding 93 (so 32 becomes 125, and 33 becomes 126). Any character outside the ASCII range 32-126 remains completely unchanged.
